address: 132 State St, Los Altos, CA 94022
w: Michelin Guide (2025) modern-Indian dining room from chef Manish Tyagi and Anupam Bhatia; the slow-cooked dum ki boti lamb curry and the spinach-and-paneer 'lasagna' with fenugreek and browned garlic are the standouts. (Los Altos, mapped to the Mountain View cluster.)
sources: paloaltoonline.com/blogs/p/2020/12/24 — 'August 1 Five chef opens Indian restaurant in Los Altos' (Aurum, 132 State St)

address: 357 Castro St, Mountain View, CA 94041
w: KQED South Bay favorite: chef Sachin Chopra's glossy, multi-regional contemporary Indian room on Castro Street; go for the gol gappa (pani puri) shots and tandoori specialties.
sources: Restaurant review: Sakoon's food lives up to vibrancy and color of decor — https://www.mv-voice.com/uncategorized/2009/10/02/restaurant-review-sakoons-food-lives-up-to-vibrancy-and-color-of-decor/

address: 1305 S Mary Ave, Sunnyvale, CA 94087

address: 458 Barber Ln, Milpitas, CA 95035
w: The Bay Area branch of the 40-year Chennai Chettinad chain; the fragrant seeraga samba mutton biryani and pepper-heavy Chettinad curries are why it stays packed. (Milpitas, mapped to the Santa Clara cluster.)

w: One of the valley's most-reviewed Andhra kitchens; the namesake ulavacharu biryani (built on the tangy horse-gram broth) and fiery Telugu home-style curries are the draw.

address: 5968 Silver Creek Valley Rd, Ste 20, San Jose, CA 95138
w: South San Jose homestyle Tamil Nadu cooking singled out by the SF Chronicle for dishes still rare on American Indian menus; the banana-leaf saapaadu meals and Chettinad mutton curry are the reason to make the drive.

w: KQED South Bay pick for hearty North Indian plus a sharp Indo-Chinese streak; the sizzling chili paneer and fresh-from-the-tandoor naan are the go-tos. (Milpitas, mapped to the Santa Clara cluster.)

address: 1177 W El Camino Real, Sunnyvale, CA 94087
w: KQED-recommended Sunnyvale mainstay for South Indian vegetarian; the yard-long paper masala dosa and medu vada with sambar are the signatures.

address: 920 E Arques Ave, Sunnyvale, CA 94085

address: 594 E El Camino Real, Sunnyvale, CA 94087
w: Small Sunnyvale room devoted to Hyderabadi Telangana home cooking; the authentic Hyderabadi dum biryani and bagara rice with mirchi ka salan are the specialties.

address: 1136 S De Anza Blvd, Ste B, San Jose, CA 95129
w: Kongunadu (Coimbatore-region) vegetarian cafe founded by homesick Bay Area techies; the ghee podi idli and paper roast dosa with filter coffee are the comfort orders.

address: 1208 S Abel St, Milpitas, CA 95035

w: KQED South Bay pick for homestyle North Indian; the aromatic goat biryani and vegetable pakora anchor a well-liked lunch buffet.
